title: Where to Watch Catch! Teenieping: Every Season, Season 7 and the Movies (2026)
summary: Every legal way to watch Catch! Teenieping in English: Netflix, Prime Video, free options on Tubi, Roku and YouTube, plus Season 7 and the movies.
body_markdown:
**Quick answer:** In the US you can watch **Catch! Teenieping** in English on **Netflix** and **Amazon Prime Video** , or free with ads on **Tubi** and **The Roku Channel** , according to[JustWatch](https://www.justwatch.com/us/tv-show/kaeci-tiniping) listings in November 2026. SAMG’s official English YouTube channel,[TeeniepingTV](https://www.youtube.com/@teeniepingTV_eng) , also posts full episodes and compilations for free. The brand-new **Season 7** premiered in Korea on **November 18, 2026** , on JEI TV and Disney+.


This guide covers every legal way to watch, which seasons come in which order, where the new season and the two movies stand, and how to avoid sketchy re-upload sites. Streaming catalogs change by country and by month, so treat the lists below as a starting point and check the season list inside each app.

##


Where to Watch Catch! Teenieping at a Glance


#


Service Cost What you get Notes


**Netflix** Subscription (incl. ad plan) English-language episodes of the series Netflix lists the show as TV-Y7. Seasons offered vary by country.


**Amazon Prime Video** Included with Prime; episodes can also be bought English audio and English subtitles The Prime Video page for *Twinkle Catch! Teenieping* lists English audio and English \[CC\] subtitles.


**Tubi** Free with ads Free streaming Listed by JustWatch for the US.


**The Roku Channel** Free with ads Free streaming Listed by JustWatch for the US.


**TeeniepingTV on YouTube** Free Full episodes, compilations, shorts and live streams Run by SAMG Entertainment, the show’s creator.


**Disney+** Subscription Season 7 in Korea; all six earlier seasons and the first movie on Disney+ Korea SAMG announced the Disney+ Korea rollout. Availability elsewhere depends on your region.


Tip: availability is licensed country by country. If you’re outside the US, open[JustWatch](https://www.justwatch.com/us/tv-show/kaeci-tiniping) and switch the country to see your local options.


##


Can You Watch Catch! Teenieping for Free?


#


Yes, and legally. You have three good free options:


- **[TeeniepingTV](https://www.youtube.com/@teeniepingTV_eng) (YouTube)** : SAMG’s official English channel. It uploads full episodes, themed compilations (for example Halloween collections) and 24/7 live streams of older seasons. Everything there is posted by the rights holder.
- **Tubi** : free with ads in the US.
- **The Roku Channel** : free with ads in the US.


Skip the random “watch cartoons online” sites. They usually host unlicensed re-uploads, push pop-up ads and malware, and they don’t support the people who make the show. The official YouTube channel is free anyway.


##


Catch! Teenieping Seasons in Watch Order


#


The English title stays *Catch! Teenieping* on most services, but each season has its own name. Here is the order, with the episode counts from SAMG’s official site:


# Season title Year Episodes Teenieping group


1 *Catch! Teenieping* ( *Fairies of Emotion* ) 2020 52 × 11 min Emotion Teeniepings


2 *Twinkle Catch! Teenieping* 2021 26 × 11 min Jewel Teeniepings


3 *Secret Catch! Teenieping* 2022 26 × 11 min Key Teeniepings


4 *Dessert Catch! Teenieping* 2023 26 × 11 min Dessert Teeniepings


5 *Star Catch! Teenieping* 2024 26 × 11 min Star Teeniepings


6 *Princess Catch! Teenieping* 2025 26 × 11 min Princess Teeniepings


7 *Jewel Catch! Teenieping* (announced as *Jewel Star Catch! Teenieping* ) 2026 20 × 11 min Stage Teeniepings


Each season mostly stands on its own: a new group of Teeniepings lands in Harmony Town and Romi has to catch them. Still, watching in order helps, because characters like Jennie and the Royal Teeniepings carry over and change between seasons. Not sure who’s who? Our[Teenieping characters list](https://www.redbean.ai/blog/teenieping-characters) breaks down every Royal Teenieping season by season.


##


Where to Watch Season 7: Jewel Catch! Teenieping


#


According to[SAMG’s Season 7 announcement](https://www.samg.net/en/news/20261106-x3cdhz) , Season 7 premiered on **November 18, 2026** , on **JEI TV at 7 p.m. KST** , followed by **Disney+ at 8 p.m.** It has **20 episodes** of 11 minutes each. SAMG’s press release calls it *Jewel Star Catch! Teenieping* , while the official SAMG show page uses *Jewel Catch! Teenieping* , so you may see both titles.


© SAMG


The story is set around the **Emotion Festival** , the Emotion Kingdom’s biggest music event. The Legend Teeniepings who were meant to headline it go missing, and Romi teams up with new Royal Teeniepings to find them. **Heartsping** , **Lemonping** (spotlight), **Cherryping** (diligence) and **Limeping** (beat) perform as **T-nyz** , a fictional idol group, and the K-pop virtual group **PLAVE** contributes the song “Heart Stage”.


SAMG has not announced an English dub or a US streaming date for Season 7 as of November 19, 2026.


##


Where to Watch the Teenieping Movies


#


- ***Heartsping: Teenieping of Love*** (85 min, released in Korean theaters on August 7, 2024). It tells how Romi first met Heartsping. SAMG says it drew **1.24 million admissions** , a record for a Korean animated feature, and it arrived on **Disney+ Korea on July 24, 2026** . In November 2026 streaming guides list no US streaming option.
- ***Teenieping: Legend of the Whale Heartstone*** (105 min, released in Korean theaters on August 5, 2026). Romi, Heartsping and a boy from the sea named Kite dive into the ocean to find Romi’s mother, Belita. It is the second film in a planned trilogy.


© SAMG


Neither film has an announced US release. If you see a “full movie in English” link on a random site, it is almost certainly unofficial.


##


Is Catch! Teenieping OK for Teens?


#


Netflix and Prime Video rate the series **TV-Y7** , and the episodes are short (about 11 minutes), so it’s easy to binge. Plenty of teen and adult fans watch it for the character designs, the magical-girl transformations and the merch-worthy Teeniepings, and it’s a big source of fan art and OCs. Prime Video also flags flashing lights and strobing patterns, which is worth knowing if you’re photosensitive.

##


FAQ


#


###


Where can I watch Catch! Teenieping in English?


#


In the US it streams on Netflix and Amazon Prime Video, and free with ads on Tubi and The Roku Channel, according to JustWatch in November 2026. SAMG’s official English YouTube channel, TeeniepingTV, also posts full episodes for free.


###


Is Catch! Teenieping on Netflix?


#


Yes. Netflix carries Catch! Teenieping (rated TV-Y7) in the US. Which seasons are available depends on your country, so check the season list in the Netflix app.


###


Can I watch Catch! Teenieping for free?


#


Yes. The official TeeniepingTV YouTube channel posts full episodes and compilations, and Tubi and The Roku Channel stream the show free with ads in the US.


###


When did Catch! Teenieping Season 7 come out?


#


Season 7 premiered in Korea on November 18, 2026, on JEI TV at 7 p.m. KST and on Disney+ at 8 p.m. It has 20 episodes of 11 minutes each.


###


How many seasons of Catch! Teenieping are there?


#


There are seven seasons: Catch! Teenieping, Twinkle, Secret, Dessert, Star, Princess and the 2026 Season 7, Jewel (Star) Catch! Teenieping. There are also two movies.


###


Where can I watch the Heartsping movie?


#


Heartsping: Teenieping of Love came to Disney+ Korea on July 24, 2026. As of November 2026 it has no US streaming release.
